subject: Crestline Analytics — service account + API key seed plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@crestline.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Crestline onboarding — service account and API key plan

Hi Elena — great to meet you on the call earlier. As promised, I wanted to outline the initial onboarding steps we'll take to get Crestline's tenant live on Redwood. High-level asks from our side so we can scope the implementation and seed credentials: 

1) Project & service account: We'll create a project namespace for Crestline (recommended name: crestline-prod) and seed two service accounts: one for ingestion (long-lived, restricted to embeddings & storage) and one for short-lived API usage (rotated via our CLI). Please confirm the preferred project name and any org-level restrictions.

2) Admin invites: We'll send invites for 2 admin seats (you + one infra lead). Confirm the email for the second seat.

3) SSO & SAML: Is your identity team available to share SAML metadata or should we proceed with email invites for now?

4) Compliance artifacts: I'll loop in Monica for SOC2 and data handling questions — procurement may require a short evidence pack.

Attached is a short checklist we use for seeding keys and a template service account JSON for your SREs to review. If this looks good I can send the invites and seed the service account templates into the project.

Next step: let me know preferred admin second contact and whether SAML should be queued. Happy to do a short 30-minute kickoff next week.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Customer Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- crestline_impl_plan_v1.pdf (2 pages, onboarding checklist)
- service_account_seed_template.json (stub)
From: Elena Park <elena.park@crestline.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@crestline.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Crestline onboarding — service account and API key plan

Ben — thanks for the clear outline. A few quick items from our side: 

- Admin second contact: Miguel Santos (miguel.santos@crestline.com) — he'll be the infra owner.
- SAML: We'd prefer SSO via SAML but our identity team needs a short lead time. Can you proceed with invites in the meantime?
- Compliance: Procurement asked for our SOC2 in addition to your evidence pack; sending that over now.

Couple of technical Qs for your SREs: 
- Does the ingestion service account need network egress whitelisting? Our network team prefers to pre-authorize endpoints.
- Rotation cadence: What's Redwood's recommended rotation for the short-lived API key?

If you can seed the templates and send invites, we'll have Miguel accept and start the SAML exchange. We can do a kickoff on Tue 28th in the afternoon PST if that works for your team.

Best,
Elena
Director of Platform
Crestline Analytics
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Crestline — prep for seed and compliance packet

Ben/Connor — internal note before we respond to procurement: 

- I'll compile the minimal SOC2 evidence bundle (system boundaries + control owner contacts). Procurement usually wants a one-pager; I'll attach crestline_impl_plan_v1.pdf with the evidence callouts.
- Network egress: default public endpoints unless they request VPC peering; for now, advise they whitelist *.redwood-inference.com and our IP range (stub in template).
- Rotation: recommend 7-day rotation for short-lived key when used in CI; 30 days for service-account long-lived secrets with HSM-backed storage. We'll propose automated rotation via our CLI and include a small script in the Drive folder.

I'll draft the reply with the plan + attach service_account_seed_template.json. Connor, can you pre-seed the project namespace (crestline-prod) and create the two service account stubs so we can hand them off in the kickoff? ETA: end of day Monday.

Thanks,
Monica
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@crestline.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@crestline.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, procurement@crestline.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Crestline onboarding — service account and API key plan

Thanks Elena — quick update and concrete next steps (copying Miguel and procurement):

1) Project & seeds (action: Connor)
- Project namespace: crestline-prod (confirmed). Connor will create crestline-prod and seed two service accounts: crestline-ingest-sa and crestline-api-sa.
- Attached: service_account_seed_template.json (fields filled for your infra team to review).

2) Admin invites (action: Ben)
- Invites sent to: elena.park@crestline.com, miguel.santos@crestline.com — you'll receive an email with account setup + optional SAML link.

3) SSO path (action: Elena/Miguel)
- We'll proceed with invites now; once Miguel has accepted we'll exchange SAML metadata. I'll include the metadata endpoint and the ACS/EntityID in the kickoff notes.

4) Network/egress (action: Crestline network)
- Please whitelist our endpoints: api.redwood-inference.com and the CIDR listed in crestline_impl_plan_v1.pdf. If you'd rather use VPC peering, let us know and we'll open a request.

5) Rotation recommendations
- Short-lived API tokens: rotate every 7 days and use ephemeral tokens for CI.
- Service-account secrets (ingest): rotate every 30 days, store in your KMS; use our automated rotation helper (see Drive).

Attachments included: 
- service_account_seed_template.json (JSON stub for your SREs)
- crestline_impl_plan_v1.pdf (onboarding checklist & egress CIDR)

I'll schedule the kickoff for Tue Jul 28 at 2:00pm PST as discussed — attaching the calendar invite. If that time doesn't work for the team, propose alternatives and we'll adjust.

Onward — excited to get crestline-prod live.

Ben

> > Hi Elena — great to meet you on the call earlier. As promised, I wanted to outline the initial onboarding steps we'll take to get Crestline's tenant live on Redwood...
From: Elena Park <elena.park@crestline.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@crestline.com>, procurement@crestline.com
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Crestline onboarding — service account and API key plan

Ben/Monica/Connor — thanks for the clear plan and the templates. Miguel accepted the invite and our identity team will start the SAML work this week. Procurement confirmed receipt of your SOC2 bundle — they look fine.

A couple final asks before the kickoff: 
- Can you include a short checklist for our SREs showing exact IAM permissions (least privilege) for crestline-ingest-sa?
- We'd like the initial service-account secrets held in our KMS until rotation occurs. Can you confirm compatibility with AWS KMS?

Kickoff time: Tue 28th won't work for us (my mistake on dates) — could we move to Thu Aug 5 at 10:00am PST? If that works for your team, please send an updated invite.

Best,
Elena

Attachments referenced: invite_cadence.ics (calendar stub)
